name: In Treatment
description: The intimate confines of psychotherapy sessions are seen from the perspective of a therapist and individual patients.

videos.title: Laura - Week One
videos.overview: Paul learns that Laura is infatuated with him when she attends her regular Monday appointment. Paul, however, is further shocked by the revelations Laura makes regarding a steamy bar encounter.

videos.title: Alex - Week One
videos.overview: Alex is a navy pilot who entered therapy due to a mission that went awry in Iraq. Alex talks to Paul about his service in Iraq and a heart attack he suffered while exercising.

videos.title: Sophie - Week One
videos.overview: It's Sophie's first session with Paul and she's hoping to get his opinion on her emotional state following an accident. Sophie was hit by a car while riding her bike.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week One
videos.overview: Jake and Amy confront Paul for advice on whether Amy should have an abortion.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week One
videos.overview: Paul visits his therapist, Gina, after nearly a decade. Paul talks to Gina about the problems his marriage is facing and reveals his frustration with his own patients.

videos.title: Laura - Week Two
videos.overview: Paul is surprised when Laura makes a revelation regarding her boyfriend.

videos.title: Alex - Week Two
videos.overview: Alex talks to Paul about his wife and his return to the bombing scene.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Two
videos.overview: Paul offers Sophie an opinion regarding Sophie's annoyance with her parents and her gymnastics team.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Two
videos.overview: Kate forces Paul to face the reality of their marriage after an abrupt end to Jake and Amy's session.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Two
videos.overview: Paul goes on the defensive after Gina offers him a suggestion that he does not agree with.

videos.title: Laura - Week Three
videos.overview: Laura arrives late, causing Paul to question their sessions.

videos.title: Alex - Week Three
videos.overview: Alex tells Paul about an encounter he had with a patient. Meanwhile Paul compares his father to Alex.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Three
videos.overview: Paul questions Sophie regarding her parent's breakup and the relationship she is currently pursuing with her coach.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Three
videos.overview: Amy has had a miscarriage and Jake is suspicious of her reaction.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Three
videos.overview: Gina examines Paul's relationship to Laura.

videos.title: Laura - Week Four
videos.overview: Laura tells Paul about her budding relationship with Alex.

videos.title: Alex - Week Four
videos.overview: Alex discuses Laura with Paul and wonders whether his therapy is effective or not.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Four
videos.overview: Sophie recounts the events prior to her accident.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Four
videos.overview: Paul seeks to learn why Jake and Amy's relationship is so fickle.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Four
videos.overview: When Paul and Gina debate the boundaries between therapists and patients, an old wound resurfaces.

videos.title: Laura - Week Five
videos.overview: Laura makes several unexpected revelations.

videos.title: Alex - Week Five
videos.overview: Paul is pushed to the edge by Alex's knowledge of his personal life.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Five
videos.overview: Sophie's mother joins her therapy session.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Five
videos.overview: Amy makes a critical decision, while Jake has an emotional admission.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Five
videos.overview: Kate accompanies Paul to therapy. The couple discuss their marriage.

videos.title: Laura - Week Six
videos.overview: In order to demonstrate what he means, Paul brings up his past to show her about what's real and what's not.

videos.title: Alex - Week Six
videos.overview: Alex recalls one of her latest dreams which Paul needs to work out the meaning of.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Six
videos.overview: Paul tries to open Sophie up to talk about her dad and her resentment for him.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Six
videos.overview: With Jake's new look on life, Amy isn't so sure she likes it but Paul tries to bring her round to see him as a new man she can get used to.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Six
videos.overview: Kate and Paul discuss her input into his life after discussing Rosie.

videos.title: Laura - Week Seven
videos.overview: It's Rosie and Ian's turn in the spotlight this time when Laura doesn't come, allowing Paul the chance to get to know them.

videos.title: Alex - Week Seven
videos.overview: Paul is doubtful that Alex is ready for everything available to him, but he insists he is and is committed to moving forward with his life.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Seven
videos.overview: Sophie tells Paul that he is turning up in her dreams and she tries to validate her relationship with her dad.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Seven
videos.overview: Amy reveals something to Jake about her father that he finds startling.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Seven
videos.overview: With people close to him holding secrets, Paul us not too happy. Gina has a technique which works wonders for him.

videos.title: Laura - Week Eight
videos.overview: Paul has to leave the office as a tragedy has cropped up.

videos.title: Alex - Week Eight
videos.overview: Paul sticks up for his use of psychotherapy as he believes it works.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Eight
videos.overview: Paul tries to steer Sophie away from thinking everything is her fault and that there is often others who deserve the blame instead.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Eight
videos.overview: Jake believes his relationship with Amy is a lot like the one with his dad after he visits home.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Eight
videos.overview: Gina surprises Paul after he questions whether therapy actually helps.

videos.title: Sophie - Week Nine
videos.overview: Sophie finally gets the fact that her father has a lot to answer for and starts to become her own woman.

videos.title: Jake and Amy - Week Nine
videos.overview: After nine weeks of therapy, the couple finally agree on how to move foward in their life together.

videos.title: Paul and Gina - Week Nine
videos.overview: Paul must live with his actions of going after Laura in a romantic fashion.

videos.title: Mia - Week One
videos.overview: Paul answers the door at his new Brooklyn apartment to find Alex Sr., the father of the patient who died during a flight exercise last year, serving him with a law suit — he blames Paul for his son's death. When Paul shows up to discuss the case with his lawyer, he's surprised to discover Mia, a patient of his from 20 years ago

videos.title: April - Week One
videos.overview: A 23-year-old architecture student, April spends much of her first session with Paul avoiding what it is she came to talk about. She discusses her recent break-up with a fellow student named Kyle,

videos.title: Oliver - Week One
videos.overview: Sixth-grader Oliver sits with Paul in his office while they wait for Oliver's mother Bess to return from the deli and for his father Luke to arrive. Oliver suggests they play Black Jack to bide the time and chides Paul for not knowing the rules. When Oliver demands to know why he's there, Paul discovers that Oliver's parents haven't explained they're getting a divorce.

videos.title: Walter - Week One
videos.overview: CEO Walter Barnett comes to see Paul at his wife Connie's insistence, complaining of insomnia. He is surprised that Paul doesn't know who he is, given that his company has been in the business pages a lot lately

videos.title: Gina - Week One
videos.overview: Paul commutes down from New York to Maryland via Amtrak to see his kids for the weekend and pays a visit to Gina to suss out what she might say in a deposition for the malpractice suit against Paul. She assures him she doesn't see him as responsible for Alex's death but admits he didn't talk about him that much in their supervision until after he'd died.

videos.title: Mia - Week Two
videos.overview: Mia has a session with Paul to apologize for her unprofessional behavior from the week before, acknowledging she intercepted his file when his attorney couldn't be there, in order to surprise and needle him. She reveals she's been having a year-long affair with her boss Bennet, who's married.

videos.title: April - Week Two
videos.overview: April arrives at her session, furious. Her iPhone has died in the middle of a call and she asks Paul if she can use his phone. He resists, suggesting it's not the best use of her time and presses April for why she's so angry.

videos.title: Oliver - Week Two
videos.overview: Oliver and Paul talk while Bess and Luke wait to be invited in. Oliver says he doesn't want to talk about school because all of his teachers hate him because he falls asleep all of the time. He insists his classes are boring, including Humanities where they are reading 'Lord of the Flies.' Oliver insists you don't need to crash on an island for kids to be mean.

videos.title: Walter - Week Two
videos.overview: Paul's daughter Rosie visits him in Brooklyn, concerned about his law suit and that he is lonely living in New York.When Walter arrives for his session, he's convinced that Paul must have read about him by now

videos.title: Gina - Week Two
videos.overview: Paul is unsure about continuing his therapy with Gina, but winds up bringing up a teen romance and how it relates to his mom's first suicide attempt.

videos.title: Mia - Week Three
videos.overview: Paul answers the door at his new Brooklyn apartment to find Alex Sr., the father of the patient who died during a flight exercise last year, serving him with a law suit — he blames Paul for his son's death. When Paul shows up to discuss the case with his lawyer, he's surprised to discover Mia, a patient of his from 20 years ago.

videos.title: April - Week Three
videos.overview: April calls Paul, asking to come to his office immediately. She was on her way to school to turn in a project — the architectural model for a World Trade Center memorial — and has been having trouble sleeping. "Between my anxiety and my lymphoma," she says, "it's just never a good time." She describes her exhaustion as the feeling of poison in her veins, like she wants to slit her wrists to get it out.

videos.title: Oliver - Week Three
videos.overview: Bess swings by Paul's office to pick up the turtle that Oliver left behind. She explains that her son has been staying with Luke for the week, giving her some time to herself. Before leaving, she hands Paul some homemade cookies, thanking him for going "above and beyond" with the turtle. When the family arrives later for their session, Luke and Oliver talk about how much fun they had together, going to a Knicks game and hanging out at home.

videos.title: Walter - Week Three
videos.overview: Walter arrives late for his session, having already postponed it by two hours. Shouting into his cell phone as he enters, he drops his suitcase and hands Paul his garment bag. Noting that Walter seems to be in the midst of a crisis, Paul suggests they reschedule, but Walter insists there won't be a better time later. He finally turns off his cell phone and Blackberry and gives Paul his attention.

videos.title: Gina - Week Three
videos.overview: Gina explores Paul’s resentment over having to take care of his ailing father.

videos.title: Mia - Week Four
videos.overview: Mia bursts into the Monday morning session, excitedly remembering all the lurid details of her weekend's wild debauchery. But Paul wants to concern themselves over her quite Sunday brunch with her father.

videos.title: April - Week Four
videos.overview: April's health continues to be a concern for Paul, as she seems more concerned about her autistic brother's condition than her own.

videos.title: Oliver - Week Four
videos.overview: As Bess readies for a well-needed vacation, she gushes over how well Oliver has done, but Paul is skeptical that her son could not have changed that quickly.

videos.title: Walter - Week Four
videos.overview: Having to deal with the aftermath of his company's crisis, Walter looks back at the loyalty towards the family who owns it and the media's perception of him.  Paul probes Walter's deeply rooted sense of guilt.

videos.title: Gina - Week Four
videos.overview: Gina gives Paul some criticism for his constant complaints about what's missing from his life, and urges him to make peace with his bedridden father.

videos.title: Mia - Week Five
videos.overview: Among the areas touched on for this session between Paul and Mia include a discussion about mortality, being alone and making up for lost time.

videos.title: April - Week Five
videos.overview: Paul fixates on a comment April uttered about a close friend of his to explore her independent streak.

videos.title: Oliver - Week Five
videos.overview: Oliver's dad is having some issues of his own, some of which are caused by Oliver's behaviour.

videos.title: Walter - Week Five
videos.overview: Paul decides that from what he's learnt of Walter, he is more harmful to himself than others.

videos.title: Gina - Week Five
videos.overview: Paul is told by Gina to return to some previous unknown answers about his father, whilst Alex Sr. has some news to tell them.

videos.title: Mia - Week Six
videos.overview: In Mia's latest session, they look over some of the biggest issues that life throws at us.

videos.title: April - Week Six
videos.overview: When April reveals something about one of her closest friends, Paul questions her ability to rely on other people.

videos.title: Oliver - Week Six
videos.overview: Ignoring Paul's and Oliver's objections, Luke and Bess come up with a plan that will alter their family structure and dynamics.

videos.title: Walter - Week Six
videos.overview: Paul tries to get Walter to embrace his vulnerable side.

videos.title: Gina - Week Six
videos.overview: Gina and Paul clash when it's suggested that she's not personally invested in her patients.

videos.title: Mia - Week Seven
videos.overview: Mia's plan doesn't work to trap Paul so she has to re-evaluate everything.

videos.title: April - Week Seven
videos.overview: Paul is told some news by April which prompts him to ask her about her anger issues.

videos.title: Oliver - Week Seven
videos.overview: Paul attempts to put Oliver's mind at ease, and his parents have had a hard week which they can now put behind them.

videos.title: Walter - Week Seven
videos.overview: Walter wants to change himself so Paul comes up with a solution to stop Walter from falling back into his old ways.

videos.title: Gina - Week Seven
videos.overview: Paul and Gina's relationship crosses paths which makes them think what they want to get out of it.

videos.title: Sunil - Week One
videos.overview: A retired math professor from Bengal, Sunil, accompanied by his son Arun and daughter-in-law Julia, reluctantly visit Paul to discuss the death of Sunil's wife six months earlier, his subsequent displacement to the U.S., and the recent tensions he's experienced while living with his son's family.

videos.title: Frances - Week One
videos.overview: A well-known stage and screen actress, whose sister was treated by Paul 18 years earlier, begins therapy to uncover the reasons why she is "blanking out" during rehearsals for a new play.

videos.title: Jesse - Week One
videos.overview: A 16-year-old homosexual, who has been seeing Paul for some time after being caught peddling prescription drugs to classmates, talks about his troubling "pattern of promiscuity," his unsettled family life with adopted parents and a recent alarming voicemail.

videos.title: Adele - Week One
videos.overview: In order to get a new prescription for sleeping pills, an exhausted Paul visits a young, serious and intelligent therapist, and is compelled to confront deep-rooted fears about his health, his divorce, his patients, and his all-encompassing relationship with former therapist Gina Toll.

videos.title: Sunil - Week Two
videos.overview: Sunil confronts his inability to voice his frustrations as he recalls the first time he and his wife met their future daughter-in-law in Calcutta.

videos.title: Frances - Week Two
videos.overview: Frances struggles to remember what distracts her during rehearsals, and she gets defensive when Paul mentions in passing that he spoke to her sister about her illness. Meanwhile, Paul sees a neurologist to be tested for Parkinson's.

videos.title: Jesse - Week Two
videos.overview: Jesse talks about his application to a prestigious arts program at the Rhode Island School of Design.

videos.title: Adele - Week Two
videos.overview: Paul discusses Gina's book with Adele and vents about a particularly loathsome character he's certain is based on him.

videos.title: Sunil - Week Three
videos.overview: Sunil makes tea as he describes his first wedding anniversary since his wife's death.

videos.title: Frances - Week Three
videos.overview: Frances recalls her sister's one and only foray into acting in a college production, and discusses her mother's beauty before and after she became ill.

videos.title: Jesse - Week Three
videos.overview: Jesse is accompanied by his mother, but the strain of their relationship makes any kind of discussion difficult.

videos.title: Adele - Week Three
videos.overview: Paul complains of headaches the morning after taking Max to a concert to see Animal Collective, and is despondent while revealing what his son found on his computer.

videos.title: Sunil - Week Four
videos.overview: Sunil is unnerved by parallels between Arun and Julia's marriage and a romance from his youth.

videos.title: Frances - Week Four
videos.overview: Painful family memories take a toll on Frances' self-esteem.

videos.title: Jesse - Week Four
videos.overview: Paul helps Jesse see a new path to meeting his birth parents.

videos.title: Adele - Week Four
videos.overview: Adele tries to get Paul to talk about his lack of passion.

videos.title: Sunil - Week Five
videos.overview: Sunil's suspicions about Julia having an affair continue to rise.

videos.title: Frances - Week Five
videos.overview: Frances goes over her Breast Cancer test results with Paul.

videos.title: Jesse - Week Five
videos.overview: Jesse shows up unexpectedly the night before his session.

videos.title: Adele - Week Five
videos.overview: Adele tries to get Paul to acknowledge his preoccupation with a troubled relationship.

videos.title: Sunil - Week Six
videos.overview: Paul is alarmed by Sunil's unpredictable behavior at home.

videos.title: Frances - Week Six
videos.overview: Frances leans on Paul for support as her sister's health deteriorates.

videos.title: Jesse - Week Six
videos.overview: Jesse shrugs off Paul's optimism that his parents won't abandon him when he needs them most.

videos.title: Adele - Week Six
videos.overview: Adele sees Paul's chronic indecisiveness as a source of his discontent.

videos.title: Frances - Week Seven
videos.overview: Frances struggles with the prospect of losing her sister Tricia.

videos.title: Sunil - Week Seven
videos.overview: Paul is blindsided by a revelation regarding Sunil's therapy.

videos.title: Jesse - Week Seven
videos.overview: Paul tries to get Jesse to open up about a recent transgression and his relationship with his father Roberto.

videos.title: Adele - Week Seven
videos.overview: Blaming Adele for his recent setbacks with patients, Paul contemplates the future of his therapy, and his practice.

videos.title: Eladio - Week 1
videos.overview: After a troubling dream finds home health aide Eladio reaching out in the middle of the night, Brooke reestablishes boundaries as his therapist. Later, when Eladio requests medication, Brooke switches her focus to his history of insomnia.

videos.title: Colin - Week 1
videos.overview: Colin, a self-proclaimed therapy enthusiast and proud child of hippies, arrives for the first of four court-mandated sessions, but his evasiveness makes a recommendation regarding his recent release from prison difficult for Brooke.

videos.title: Laila - Week 1
videos.overview: Brooke struggles to draw genuine answers out of her newest patient Laila, who's been dragged to therapy by her concerned grandmother over recent "life choices," before switching gears and empowering the 18-year-old to seize her agency.

videos.title: Brooke - Week 1
videos.overview: After failing to honor a commitment, Brooke receives an unexpected visit from her friend Rita. Worried that Brooke is teetering on the edge of a bad decision, Rita illuminates an unexpected connection between Brooke's personal and professional lives.

videos.title: Eladio - Week 2
videos.overview: Brooke agrees to refer Eladio to a psychiatrist before his medication runs out – but only if he truly commits to therapy first. When pressed about his employers, Eladio opens up about his complicated relationship with their family.

videos.title: Colin - Week 2
videos.overview: Colin chronicles the events that took him from "gold stars all around" to receiving serious demerits in prison. After connecting his troubling behavior to a feeling of profound powerlessness, Brooke challenges Colin to accept responsibility for his actions.

videos.title: Laila - Week 2
videos.overview: In an effort to connect with Laila over feeling controlled by her family, Brooke shares a traumatic experience from her own childhood. As Brooke digs into her proclivity for unbridled imagination and storytelling as a coping mechanism, Laila reveals a surprising plan for her future.

videos.title: Brooke - Week 2
videos.overview: Though Brooke insists reuniting with Adam will not awaken destructive habits, Rita recognizes her actions as part of a recurring pattern and encourages her to spend more time embracing the present.

videos.title: Eladio - Week 3
videos.overview: With the house to himself, an energized Eladio shares the true depth of his unlikely connection to Jeremy. But when her patient shuts down on the heels of a compliment, Brooke helps Eladio sort through deep-rooted issues from his childhood.

videos.title: Colin - Week 3
videos.overview: Brooke helps Colin realize how his hyper-focus on the opinions of others has long curtailed the development of his authentic self. After testing Brooke's boundaries, Colin makes an unusual request for their final session.

videos.title: Laila - Week 3
videos.overview: As Laila details an elaborate getaway plan, a skeptical Brooke learns that her patient's desire to escape dates back to her earliest memories – and has only been accelerated by societal injustice and the impossible expectations thrust upon her.

videos.title: Brooke - Week 3
videos.overview: After receiving a distressing phone call from Brooke, Rita helps her friend process a recent complication while struggling to accept a potential shift in their relationship.

videos.title: Eladio - Week 4
videos.overview: Brooke tempers mixed reactions from Eladio after sharing an unexpected analysis. While her patient processes the news, Brooke and Adam discuss their future.

videos.title: Colin - Week 4
videos.overview: In their fourth and final court-ordered session together, Brooke mines the extent of Colin's evasiveness – and struggles to form a comprehensive picture of her patient.

videos.title: Laila - Week 4
videos.overview: Concerned over her patient's disclosure at the end of their last session, Brooke presses Laila to open up about her complicated understanding of love, sex, and the future.

videos.title: Brooke - Week 4
videos.overview: Despite throwing a serious wrench in their plans, Brooke gains unexpected clarity on her relationship with Rita.

videos.title: Eladio - Week 5
videos.overview: As Brooke contemplates a pressing life decision of her own, Eladio shares a major development. But when he asks for help sifting through the repercussions, Eladio is surprised by Brooke's answers.

videos.title: Colin - Week 5
videos.overview: On the heels of receiving Brooke's recommendation, Colin makes a surprise visit—prompting a collision of his therapist's personal and professional lives.

videos.title: Laila - Week 5
videos.overview: Torn up over the outside influences clouding her self-understanding, Laila is challenged by Brooke's unique therapy technique. But when Brooke asks Laila to take the exercise a step further, she receives a startling response.

videos.title: Brooke - Week 5
videos.overview: Brooke nervously prepares for a visit she's avoided for months. Later, there's nowhere to hide as Brooke stares down the barrel of past trauma to confront the root of her pain.

videos.title: Eladio - Week 6
videos.overview: After Eladio reaches a transformative conclusion, Brooke pushes him to break free of his self-imposed limitations.

videos.title: Colin - Week 6
videos.overview: In new territory, Brooke and Colin confront the vast work ahead.​

videos.title: Laila - Week 6
videos.overview: When Laila disappears, Brooke forces Rhonda to consider how profoundly her expectations have affected the teen.

videos.title: Brooke - Week 6
videos.overview: Fresh from her self-analysis, Brooke confronts revelations that may inform her future with her son and relationship with Adam.​

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 9 wins & 54 nominations total
